fields.headline: The terminal goes dark
fields.narration: Every flight information screen in the terminal is now black. Passengers are crowding around the airline counters, demanding information. Noise levels are high. A gate agent at A6 is standing on a chair, shouting flight numbers. Somebody in the crowd starts filming.
keyFacts: All FIDS screens are dark by Ops order
Crowds at the Skyline and HWK Air counters, Concourse A
Airline apps still show gate assignments
fields.expectedAction: Ops deploys staff with megaphones and whiteboards (Section 13.7 checklist). PIO pushes "check your airline app" messaging.
fields.facilitatorNote: Put the crowded-terminal photo on the projector while reading. If nobody mentions whiteboards within 5 minutes, have an airline rep ask: "Where do I send my passengers?"
